mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points in the past month signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 4.5%, the robust labor market boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 60-day periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 110) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of the 5-day periods when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of the 20-day periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falling) signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of the 60-day periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises faster than 0.2% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises faster than 0.1% in the past month, persistent inflation and aggressive monetary tightening lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS growth > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of the 5-day periods when CPIAUCSL growth > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS growth > 0.1%.
